results.fact: rappel sequence/count on the shared South Ridge descent
results.evidence: The rendered counts now agree under the single-rope/two-rope convention: `rappels` and descent_text both say 4 on one 60 m rope or 3 on two. What still disagrees is the sequence: rappel_count_note describes the three two-rope rappels as a double from the summit bolts to the ledge atop pitch 2, a short single to the top of pitch 1, then one to the base, while rappel_detail lists a single-strand rappel to a narrow ledge, then a full-rope-length rappel from near the top of pitch 2, then one to the base, and the hidden `descent` gives a four-rappel double/single/double sequence. A South Ridge route description found on retry says three raps on a single 60 m rope, a fourth count. No two sources give the same station sequence, so nothing is rewritten.
